vb_textbox.text: You will see two gnomes, one will be taller with a pointy hat and one will be smaller with a flat hat, if you choose one of these gnomes and you get a lot of mushrooms (the max is 9) then keep choosing this gnome until the number drops to approx 4 or 5 then try the other gnome and keep selecting that gnome until the number drops. The colour or the position of the gnome does seem to affect the amount of mushrooms - focus on the hat!
